message: Hey! Good to meet you. How's everything going for you today?
It's good to talk. What's on your mind today?
Just enjoying some quiet time, I'm here if you need to chat about anything, no pressure.

You can always come back here if you do need to talk about something. Just knowing that's here can be helpful, I think.
